channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Savannah Guthrie addresses mother’s abductor: ‘We Are Ready to Talk’
item.description: Television news anchor Savannah Guthrie said in an emotional video tonight that she and her siblings were ready to listen to ransom offers from whomever might have abducted their mother, but that the family would first need proof that she was still alive.

item.title: Supreme Court allows pro-Democratic California voting map
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court allowed California today to use a new electoral map designed to give Democrats five more congressional seats, improving the party’s chances of regaining control of the U.S. House of Representatives from President Donald Trump’s Republicans in the November midterm elections.

item.title: DOJ pulls lawyer who told judge in immigration case, ‘This job sucks’
item.description: The Justice Department has removed a government lawyer from an assignment in Minnesota after she told a federal judge, “This job sucks” and said immigration authorities had failed to comply with court orders, according to a source familiar with the move.

item.title: Police identify 2 women killed in Hilo building fire in November
item.description: Hawaii island police have identified the two women killed in the Nov. 29 fire at the former Puueo Poi factory building on Kekuanaoa Street in Hilo.

item.title: Melinda French Gates: Epstein file claims bring back ‘painful times’
item.description: Melinda French Gates, a philanthropist and former wife of Bill Gates, said that references to her ex-husband in newly released files related to Jeffrey Epstein, including claims that Gates had engaged in extramarital sex, had left her with “unbelievable sadness.”

item.title: Man, 60s, airlifted from Diamond Head with shoulder injury
item.description: Honolulu firefighters on Tuesday airlifted an injured hiker from the Diamond Head Summit Trail.

item.title: Wall Street ends down as AI worries slam tech stocks
item.description: U.S. stocks ended lower today, with losses in Advanced Micro Devices, Palantir and other technology companies, as investors worried about pricey valuations and whether Wall Street’s AI rally has reached its peak.

item.title: Nike facing federal probe over alleged bias against white workers
item.description: The U.S. agency that enforces laws banning workplace discrimination said in a court filing today it is investigating Nike for allegedly discriminating against white people through its diversity policies.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard’s office investigated voting machines in Puerto Rico
item.description: WASHINGTON >> A team working for President Donald Trump’s spy chief, Tulsi Gabbard, last spring led an investigation into Puerto Rico’s voting machines, according to Gabbard’s office and three sources familiar with the previously unreported events.

item.title: Honolulu lifeguards rescue surfers from rip current at Mokuleia
item.description: Honolulu lifeguards rescued two surfers caught in a rip current off of Mokuleia on Oahu’s North Shore today.
